Windows error guide / 0x80070070 – 0x50011

0x80070070 – 0x50011Microsoft

Check upgrade storage space

Context

This may appear when the upgrade lacks available storage space.

Checks

  1. Identify the installation drive and its displayed free space.
  2. Compare the extra space requested by Setup and check personal-file backups.

Next action

Look up the full code in Microsoft’s setup guidance; if repeated, send the code, setup phase and PC model to Microsoft Support.

Sources

  • Microsoft Support ↗
